desc: PET imaging data SHOULD be stored in 4D (or 3D, if only one volume was acquired) NIfTI files with the `_pet` suffix. Volumes MUST be stored in chronological order (the order they were acquired in). Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present.

# neuro/pet/pet
